text: P0-G IS UNBLOCKED AND IN PROGRESS - DO NOT RECORD 'VISUAL PREPROD PROOF = BLOCKED BY ENVIRONMENT' IN THE RC. I got Docker back up on this machine, rebuilt the local Supabase stack from my scripts (schema, assisted-order RPCs, EA session RPCs, 18 products / 46 variants / 46 approved prices, active member, approved EA customer), booted the dev server against the CURRENT origin head, and I am now INSIDE the Early Access flow in a real browser at 390px: both password walls passed, EA session minted, identity binding established, sitting on Step 2 of 8 with the full canonical catalog section rendering below. FIRST BROWSER-VISIBLE FINDING, and it is the same shape as the assisted-order form-acknowledgments P0 I reported yesterday: THE CLIENT HARDCODES THE AGREEMENT IT PRESENTS WHILE THE SERVER CONFIGURES WHAT IT REQUIRES, AND NOTHING RECONCILES THEM. Captured live off the wire: the client POSTs {kind:'early_access_terms',version:'v1'} (hardcoded at client/src/research/adapters/earlyAccessAgreement.ts:33) and the server answered 400 AGREEMENT_NOT_REQUIRED because RESEARCH_EARLY_ACCESS_REQUIRED_AGREEMENTS named a different pair. The customer ticks the Research Use Policy, presses Accept and continue, and is refused with no path forward. In MY case the mismatch was my own env choice, so this is not automatically a live production defect - but the structural hazard is real and silent: if the founder sets that env var to anything other than exactly early_access_terms/v1, every customer is hard-blocked at step 2 and no operator surface says the two lists disagree. LEAD: worth checking the production value of RESEARCH_EARLY_ACCESS_REQUIRED_AGREEMENTS against that hardcoded pair before the RC, because agreements sit directly on the founder P0 path between catalog and submit. I am aligning my env to the client pair and continuing to the catalog now; next report will be what the storefront actually renders at 430/390/375/360/320, asserted on the CTA the customer sees rather than product strings, with Hexarelin 5mg and Oxytocin 10mg recorded as observed rather than against either disputed price.
